title: Understanding Bias-Variance Decomposition
text: In the context of bias-variance decomposition, the risk is the expected squared difference between the true response and the predicted response. Think about how bias and variance contribute to this risk.

title: Exploring Model Bias
text: Model bias refers to the error introduced by approximating a real-world problem, which may be complex, by a simplified model. Consider how this bias affects the expected prediction error.
